ami.description: ID of AMI to use for the instance

ami_ssm_parameter.description: SSM parameter name for the AMI ID. For Amazon Linux AMI SSM parameters see [reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/parameter-store-public-parameters-ami.html)

associate_public_ip_address.description: Not supported: ACK's Instance takes it only on a network interface it creates, and its network interface spec has no security groups (Groups), so the instance's groups could not be set with it

availability_zone.description: AZ to start the instance in

capacity_reservation_specification.description: Describes an instance's Capacity Reservation targeting option

cpu_credits.description: The credit option for CPU usage (unlimited or standard)

cpu_options.description: Defines CPU options to apply to the instance at launch time.

create_eip.description: Determines whether a public EIP will be created and associated with the instance (the association is ack-extensions' EIPAssociation: needs allow_alpha)

create_iam_instance_profile.description: Determines whether an IAM instance profile is created or to use an existing IAM instance profile

create_security_group.description: Determines whether a security group will be created

create_spot_instance.description: Not supported: aws_spot_instance_request has no ACK or ack-extensions kind; instance_market_options (market_type spot) requests a Spot instance through RunInstances

disable_api_stop.description: If true, enables EC2 Instance Stop Protection

disable_api_termination.description: If true, enables EC2 Instance Termination Protection

ebs_optimized.description: If true, the launched EC2 instance will be EBS-optimized

ebs_volumes.description: Not supported: ack-extensions' VolumeAttachment takes the instance's ID with no reference to an Instance, and a Volume needs the instance's Availability Zone, which only its status has: they cannot be wired in one render

eip_domain.description: Indicates if this EIP is for use in VPC (vpc only: ACK's ElasticIPAddress has no domain)

eip_tags.description: A map of additional tags to add to the eip

enable_primary_ipv6.description: Not supported: ACK's Instance has no field for a primary IPv6 address

enable_volume_tags.description: Whether to enable volume tags (if enabled it conflicts with root_block_device tags)

enclave_options_enabled.description: Whether Nitro Enclaves will be enabled on the instance. Defaults to `false`

ephemeral_block_device.description: Customize Ephemeral (also known as Instance Store) volumes on the instance

force_destroy.description: Not supported: ACK's Instance has no field to override disable_api_stop and disable_api_termination on delete

get_password_data.description: Not supported: ACK's Instance does not read a Windows instance's password data

hibernation.description: If true, the launched EC2 instance will support hibernation

host_id.description: ID of a dedicated host that the instance will be assigned to. Use when an instance is to be launched on a specific dedicated host

host_resource_group_arn.description: ARN of the host resource group in which to launch the instances. If you specify an ARN, omit the `tenancy` parameter or set it to `host`

iam_instance_profile.description: IAM Instance Profile to launch the instance with. Specified as the name of the Instance Profile

iam_role_name.description: Name to use on IAM role created

iam_role_permissions_boundary.description: ARN of the policy that is used to set the permissions boundary for the IAM role

iam_role_policies.description: Policies attached to the IAM role

iam_role_tags.description: A map of additional tags to add to the IAM role/profile created

iam_role_use_name_prefix.description: Determines whether the IAM role name (`iam_role_name` or `name`) is used as a prefix

ignore_ami_changes.description: Whether changes to the AMI ID changes should be ignored by Terraform. Note - changing this value will result in the replacement of the instance

instance_initiated_shutdown_behavior.description: Shutdown behavior for the instance. Amazon defaults this to stop for EBS-backed instances and terminate for instance-store instances. Cannot be set on instance-store instance

instance_market_options.description: The market (purchasing) option for the instance. If set, overrides the `create_spot_instance` variable

instance_type.description: The type of instance to start

ipv6_address_count.description: A number of IPv6 addresses to associate with the primary network interface. Amazon EC2 chooses the IPv6 addresses from the range of your subnet

ipv6_addresses.description: Specify one or more IPv6 addresses from the range of the subnet to associate with the primary network interface

key_name.description: Key name of the Key Pair to use for the instance; which can be managed using the `aws_key_pair` resource

launch_template.description: Specifies a Launch Template to configure the instance. Parameters configured on this resource will override the corresponding parameters in the Launch Template

maintenance_options.description: The maintenance options for the instance

metadata_options.description: Customize the metadata options of the instance

monitoring.description: If true, the launched EC2 instance will have detailed monitoring enabled

name.description: Name to be used on EC2 instance created

network_interface.description: Customize network interfaces to be attached at instance boot time

placement_group.description: The Placement Group to start the instance in

placement_group_id.description: Not supported: ACK's Instance places an instance by group name only (placement_group)

placement_partition_number.description: Number of the partition the instance is in. Valid only if the `aws_placement_group` resource's `strategy` argument is set to `partition`

private_dns_name_options.description: Customize the private DNS name options of the instance

private_ip.description: Private IP address to associate with the instance in a VPC

putin_khuylo.description: Do you agree that Putin doesn't respect Ukrainian sovereignty and territorial integrity? More info: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Putin_khuylo!

region.description: Region where the resource(s) will be managed. Defaults to the Region set in the provider configuration

root_block_device.description: Not supported: the root device's name depends on the AMI, which the chart does not read, and ACK's blockDeviceMappings need the name

secondary_network_interface.description: Not supported: ACK's Instance has no secondary network interfaces

secondary_private_ips.description: Not supported: ACK's Instance takes it only on a network interface it creates, and its network interface spec has no security groups (Groups), so the instance's groups could not be set with it

security_group_description.description: Not supported: used only by the security group create_security_group makes, which is refused (ACK's Instance takes security group IDs, with no reference)

security_group_egress_rules.description: Not supported: used only by the security group create_security_group makes, which is refused (ACK's Instance takes security group IDs, with no reference)

security_group_ingress_rules.description: Not supported: used only by the security group create_security_group makes, which is refused (ACK's Instance takes security group IDs, with no reference)

security_group_name.description: Not supported: used only by the security group create_security_group makes, which is refused (ACK's Instance takes security group IDs, with no reference)

security_group_tags.description: Not supported: used only by the security group create_security_group makes, which is refused (ACK's Instance takes security group IDs, with no reference)

security_group_use_name_prefix.description: Not supported: used only by the security group create_security_group makes, which is refused (ACK's Instance takes security group IDs, with no reference)

security_group_vpc_id.description: Not supported: used only by the security group create_security_group makes, which is refused (ACK's Instance takes security group IDs, with no reference)

source_dest_check.description: Controls if traffic is routed to the instance when the destination address does not match the instance. Used for NAT or VPNs

spot_instance_interruption_behavior.description: Not supported: aws_spot_instance_request has no ACK or ack-extensions kind; instance_market_options (market_type spot) requests a Spot instance through RunInstances

spot_launch_group.description: Not supported: aws_spot_instance_request has no ACK or ack-extensions kind; instance_market_options (market_type spot) requests a Spot instance through RunInstances

spot_price.description: Not supported: aws_spot_instance_request has no ACK or ack-extensions kind; instance_market_options (market_type spot) requests a Spot instance through RunInstances

spot_type.description: Not supported: aws_spot_instance_request has no ACK or ack-extensions kind; instance_market_options (market_type spot) requests a Spot instance through RunInstances

spot_valid_from.description: Not supported: aws_spot_instance_request has no ACK or ack-extensions kind; instance_market_options (market_type spot) requests a Spot instance through RunInstances

spot_valid_until.description: Not supported: aws_spot_instance_request has no ACK or ack-extensions kind; instance_market_options (market_type spot) requests a Spot instance through RunInstances

spot_wait_for_fulfillment.description: Not supported: aws_spot_instance_request has no ACK or ack-extensions kind; instance_market_options (market_type spot) requests a Spot instance through RunInstances

subnet_id.description: The VPC Subnet ID to launch in

tags.description: A mapping of tags to assign to the resource

tenancy.description: The tenancy of the instance (if the instance is running in a VPC). Available values: default, dedicated, host

timeouts.description: Not supported: Terraform's create, update and delete timeouts: ACK retries until the instance is synced, and Bundt waits for it

user_data.description: The user data to provide when launching the instance. Do not pass gzip-compressed data via this argument; see user_data_base64 instead

user_data_base64.description: Can be used instead of user_data to pass base64-encoded binary data directly. Use this instead of user_data whenever the value is not a valid UTF-8 string. For example, gzip-encoded user data must be base64-encoded and passed via this argument to avoid corruption

user_data_replace_on_change.description: Not supported: ACK updates an instance's user data in place; it never replaces an instance

volume_tags.description: Not supported: ACK tags the volumes an instance launches with the instance's own tags; volume tags of their own have no field

vpc_security_group_ids.description: A list of security group IDs to associate with
